description: Free. One asset's public page in one snapshot: price, market cap, how the tracked Hyperliquid traders are positioned, their recent moves, and how many dated catalysts are ahead; why: what happened around its 24h move, from Fexr's data; market_hours: whether equities, commodities and crypto are trading now (equities follow NYSE hours). Public page: https://app.fexr.io/markets/{asset}. Deeper: get_predictive_signals, get_catalysts, get_token_unlocks.
